episodes.title: "ANTIFA Is Not Dead": Terrorism, Corruption, and Violence | Andy Ngo
episodes.description:
Independent journalist Andy Ngo joins Michael Knowles for a hard-hitting interview exposing the current state of Antifa. Despite claims that the militant group is finished, Ngo reveals how Antifa continues to operate through organized violence, political corruption, and domestic terrorism across American cities.From their tactics on the streets to their infiltration of institutions, Ngo breaks down the real threat Antifa poses today — backed by years of on-the-ground reporting and documentation.
